_readme: Every number and the routing table for the overnight edit queue. Dan's decisions live here so one row can be flipped without touching code. Procedure: scripts/edit-queue/README.md.

routing._decided: Dan, 2026-09-17. A fixed rule, not an A/B test. No automatic re-routing: a change is Dan's call.

unattended._why: Phase 1 pilot: jobs with no AI-clip slots, small only. Widen in Phase 3, after Phase 2 builds the placeholder flow for raw cuts.

codex._proven: 2026-09-17 smoke test: write to the work dir, project ffmpeg, queue.py, rclone to Drive, all with no prompt. workspace-write blocks rclone's token refresh unless ~/.config/rclone is writable. If a full edit hits a sandbox wall, set sandbox to danger-full-access, which is what Dan's own ~/.codex/config.toml already uses.

claude._unproven: 2026-09-17: the binary answers 'Not logged in'. Dan signs in once (run the binary in Terminal, /login). The flags below are what this project's settings.local.json already grants (bypassPermissions) plus a deny list; they have NOT been run on a full job yet.
